prediction.training_target: mean of three replicate-specific N_eq; single=1, multi>1
prediction.ensemble_rule: Average per-seed probabilities and per-seed contribution matrices, never model weights.
prediction.contribution_sign: positive supports multi-PB; negative supports single-PB
prediction.coordinates: input-sequence positions; map to structure by alignment, not an assumed offset
prediction.structure: optional visualization input, not an ESMfluc prediction input

band_detection.profile: mean of the three per-seed I_j profiles
band_detection.note: Use the archived detector for endpoint, zero-MAD and merging behavior.

public_derivative_note: Informational derivative of the historical deposit manifest: portable source paths and only active final training arguments. Original deposit hashes and source/tensor checksums remain historical. Download the original manifest with weights for checkpoint restoration.
